name: Monogamy
overview: Scripture presents monogamy as the God-ordained design for marriage, beginning in Genesis where God creates a suitable helper for man and establishes that a man shall leave his parents and unite with one wife to become one flesh. The wisdom literature affirms the value and virtue of a single, godly wife as a blessing and crown to her husband. Additionally, Deuteronomy warns against multiplying wives, highlighting the importance of faithfulness and a heart devoted solely to one spouse, reflecting God's intended pattern for marriage.
